name: launchpad
description: A welcome menu of one-click actions under the header: each button runs an installed command, skill or agent. Pick and order up to 8 with /pad configuration

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the default buttons and messages. auto follows the system's LANG: Portuguese for pt_*, English otherwise and when LANG is unset

icons.title: Icons in the terminal
icons.description: emoji reads best; symbol keeps columns aligned in terminals that draw emoji at odd widths; auto uses symbol in a JetBrains IDE's terminal and emoji elsewhere

showOnStart.title: Show on start
showOnStart.description: Show the menu when a session starts and after /clear. Off: only /pad shows it
